scope: Investigation only; production code, user archives and database unchanged

units.timings: single serial warm-cache measurements, not p95 or cold restore

inputs.captureRuntime: Node 26.3.0, explicit GC once before unchanged Heatmap admission; not production import latency
inputs.codecRuntime: Bundled Electron 44.5.1 / Node 24.21.0, run-as-node; independent per-component codecs

samples.purpose: Read-only capacity investigation; codec/structural results are not a deployable archive format
limits: One serial warm-cache run; timings are observations, not latency p95 or production SLAs
Codec bytes are compressed member payloads; current manifest overhead is reported separately
Structural candidates include their dictionary/schema headers but need a versioned archive manifest
No codec installed-app/cold-restore or prototype peak-memory acceptance is implied
No sampling reduction, numeric quantization, evidence pruning, DEM copying or live archive mutation
